name: PT Yanaprima Hastapersada Tbk
summary: PT Yanaprima Hastapersada Tbk manufactures and sells polypropylene (PP) polymer laminated woven bags in Indonesia, Asia, and South America. It operates in four segments: Plastic Bags; Cement Bags; Roll Sheet and Sandwich Sheet; and Others. The company offers plastic bags, laminated bags, cement sacks, roll sheets, sandwich sheets, and PP woven block bottom bags. Its products are used for packaging cement, sugar, fertilizer, rice, and other commodities. It exports its products. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Yanaprima Hastapersada Tbk is a subsidiary of PT. Hastagraha Bumipersada.
